event_time: first_complete_score_availability=max(received_at,scored_at) within current source-scoped algorithmic event group
revision_rule: latest fully scored article version available by cutoff; revisions do not create a second first event; cross-day updates counted separately
partial_article: exclude whole article version unless all expected segments under frozen scoring config are DONE; retain failure evidence
event_grouping: source-scoped, existing event_group_id; revisions of one article connect groups only when available by as_of; cross-source duplicates not merged without verified rule
n1: equal mean of net text tone for new directly company-associated algorithmic event groups in daily window; missing when none
n2: observed count of those new event groups; complete count null when source continuity unproven
initial_window: PARTIAL_INITIAL_WINDOW if research origin is later than window_start
snapshot_release: append-only data commit, append-only completion receipt, then append-only release gate after completion commit; signal_available_at has 60 second conservative guard and is invalid if release commit exceeds it
idempotency: same snapshot_id returns stored kind and original times; manifest conflict raises without overwrite

labels.entry: next eligible regular US session opening auction proxy only after signal available
labels.exit: regular close of entry day or fifth eligible session
labels.price_policy: verified open, close, corporate actions and source required; quote cache not accepted

limits: no old trusted AI explanation worker
